description: Current air quality for a place: PM2.5, PM10, ozone, NO2, SO2, CO and dust, plus the US and European AQI and the US AQI band ('Good', 'Unhealthy'). Takes a place name — no coordinates needed. (Free. This server also sells a paid API — call `paid_catalogue` for the routes and prices; x402 over USDC on Base, no signup.)
name: air_quality
